# RealIRacing

> RealIRacing (realiracing.com) is an iRacing sim racing site by Carlos Martinez: practical guides on force feedback settings, wheel and pedal buyer's guides, safety rating and racecraft, car and track guides, and OBS streaming setups, plus race highlights, setup guides and rig tours on the @realtape YouTube channel. Real motorsport roots, tested on a real rig.

## About
- Author: Carlos Martinez (iRacing user "Carlos Martinez9"). Home: https://realiracing.com/
- Rig: MOZA R9 direct drive wheelbase, MOZA CS V2 wheel, MOZA SR-P pedals, RTX 5060 Ti, 1440p 120 Hz monitor. Full breakdown: https://realiracing.com/gear.html
- Affiliate disclosure: gear links go to Amazon and carry an affiliate tag; the author may earn a commission at no cost to the reader. The site does not use sponsored loaner hardware.
- 30 blog guides published so far; new posts appear several times a week.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://realiracing.com/): channel overview, content types, gear picks, FAQ
- [Blog](https://realiracing.com/blog/): all iRacing guides, settings and gear advice
- [My Rig](https://realiracing.com/gear.html): every part Carlos races and streams on, with notes on why
- [Link hub](https://realiracing.com/go/): all platforms in one place
- [YouTube @realtape](https://www.youtube.com/@realtape): race highlights, setup guides, rig tours, iRacing tips
- Social: [Instagram @realiracing](https://www.instagram.com/realiracing) · [TikTok @realiracing](https://www.tiktok.com/@realiracing) · [X @realiracing](https://x.com/realiracing)

## All blog posts (newest first)

- [iRacing Active Reset: Practise One Corner on Repeat](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-active-reset-practise-one-corner-on-repeat.html): How I use iRacing Active Reset on a MOZA R9 and CRP2 rig to drill a single braking zone: the two binds, the save point and a one-variable drill.
- [Back Up Your iRacing Settings Before an Update or Reinstall: What I Copy and How I Restore on a MOZA R9 Rig](https://realiracing.com/blog/back-up-iracing-settings-before-update-reinstall-moza-r9.html): What to copy from Documents\iRacing, what lives in MOZA Pit House instead, and how I restore both on a MOZA R9 and CRP2 rig after an update or reinstall.
- [MOZA Pit House Presets for iRacing: One Per Car Class](https://realiracing.com/blog/moza-pit-house-presets-iracing-one-per-car-class.html): How I organise MOZA Pit House presets for iRacing on an R9, one per car class, with the naming scheme and what changes for GT3, formula and oval.
- [iRacing Dynamic Track: Rubber, Marbles and Temperature](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-dynamic-track-rubber-marbles-track-temperature.html): A beginner guide to iRacing's dynamic track: how rubber, marbles and track temperature change grip, and what I do about each from my MOZA R9 rig.
- [iRacing Week 13: What I Do in the Off-Week | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-week-13-off-week-between-seasons-checklist.html): Week 13 is the quiet gap between iRacing seasons. Here is how I use it on my MOZA R9 rig: rest, rig checks, calibration, FFB cleanup and practice.
- [First Week With a New Wheelbase: iRacing Setup Checklist](https://realiracing.com/blog/first-week-new-wheelbase-iracing-setup-checklist.html): A day-by-day plan for your first week with a new direct drive wheelbase, from tightening bolts to your first iRacing race, based on my MOZA R9 rig.
- [iRacing Black Flag and Meatball Flag: How to Clear Them](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-black-flag-meatball-flag-explained.html): A first-person guide to serving an iRacing black flag penalty and answering a meatball repair flag without throwing away the rest of your race.
- [iRacing Local Yellow Flags: What to Do on Road Courses](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-local-yellow-flags-road-courses-what-to-do.html): A yellow shows up ahead on an iRacing road course. What it means, how I slow down without losing the race, and how to rejoin safely after your own spin.
- [GTA 6 Driving: A Sim Racer's First Hours on Xbox Series X](https://realiracing.com/blog/gta-6-driving-sim-racers-first-hours-xbox-series-x.html): A sim racer's first hours of GTA 6 driving on Xbox Series X with a controller: the vehicles, five driving moments, and how the stream was set up without a capture card.
- [iRacing Fixed vs Open Setup Series: Which to Race First](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-fixed-vs-open-setup-series-which-first.html): Fixed setup or open setup in iRacing? What each format locks, what it leaves to you, and how I decide which series to race on a given week.
- [iRacing Tow and Fast Repairs: Reset or Save the Repair?](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-tow-fast-repair-reset-or-save.html): What an iRacing tow actually does, how fast repairs work, and how to decide before the green flag whether to reset or keep limping home after a crash.
- [iRacing Min Force: Fixing a Dead Centre on Direct Drive](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-min-force-dead-centre-direct-drive.html): What iRacing's Min Force does, why direct-drive owners leave it at zero, when it helps weaker bases, and a one-change test you can run in an evening.
- [iRacing Button Mapping: What I Bind to My Wheel Buttons First](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-button-mapping-wheel-buttons-first-binds.html): A rim only has a handful of buttons. Here is which iRacing controls I put under my thumbs first, and which ones I leave on the keyboard.
- [iRacing Virtual Mirror and Look Left/Right: Seeing the Cars Beside You on One Screen](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-virtual-mirror-look-left-right-single-screen.html): How I combine the iRacing virtual mirror, look left/right buttons, the Relative and the spotter to avoid side contact on a single monitor.
- [Blue flags in iRacing: getting lapped and lapping cleanly](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-blue-flags-being-lapped-and-lapping-cleanly.html): What the blue flag means in iRacing, what the lapped car should do, and how the leader gets past without a 4x. Notes from my own rig.
- [Night racing in iRacing: seeing the track after dark](https://realiracing.com/blog/night-racing-iracing-seeing-the-track-after-dark.html): How I set up my monitor, pick braking markers and handle headlights in the mirrors so night stints in iRacing endurance races stop feeling like guesswork.
- [The beginner mistakes that cost new iRacing drivers the most](https://realiracing.com/blog/beginner-mistakes-first-season-iracing.html): The six habits that quietly cost new iRacing drivers the most positions in their first season, and how to fix each one from the MOZA R9 rig.
- [iRacing Black Boxes Explained: Relative, Fuel, Tires](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-black-boxes-explained-relative-fuel-tires.html): What each iRacing black box shows, which one to keep up in a race, and how to map them to wheel buttons so fuel and tires are set before pit entry.
- [ABS and Traction Control in iRacing: When to Use Them and When to Turn Them Off](https://realiracing.com/blog/abs-and-traction-control-in-iracing-when-to-use-them.html): ABS and traction control help you stay on track but hide feedback. Here is how I decide when to keep them on, when to lower them, and what they change.
- [iRacing Endurance Classics: Daytona 24, Sebring 12, Spa 24, Petit Le Mans](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-endurance-classics-daytona-sebring-spa-petit.html): Survive iRacing's toughest multi-hour events. Learn fuel strategy, driver discipline, and setup for 12- and 24-hour classics.
- [iRacing Season Structure and Build Updates Explained](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-season-structure-build-updates-explained.html): How iRacing seasons work, when builds update, and how to plan your racing calendar and setup changes around the schedule.
- [Rudskogen Motorsports Park iRacing: Setup, Grip Zones, Braking Points](https://realiracing.com/blog/rudskogen-motorsports-park-iracing-guide.html): Master Rudskogen's fast sweepers and technical corners with setup priorities, braking references, and tire management for consistent pace.
- [Throttle Pedal Feel: Travel, Spring and Calibration](https://realiracing.com/blog/throttle-pedal-feel-load-cell-travel-spring-calibration.html): How I set up the throttle on my MOZA CRP2 pedals for smoother exits: travel, spring choice, plate angle and calibration, with the mistakes I made first.
- [iRacing Pit Road Etiquette: How I Stopped Taking Speeding Penalties](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-pit-road-etiquette-avoid-speeding-penalties.html): How I approach iRacing pit road with a MOZA R9 and CRP2: limiter timing, entry line, box position and exit, so speeding penalties stop costing races.
- [My iRacing pre-race routine: the five minutes before green](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-pre-race-routine-five-minutes-before-green.html): The checks I run between qualifying and the green flag in iRacing: fuel, setup, brake bias, FFB, pedals, the entry list and a calm head for turn one.
- [Grip pressure and hand position on a direct drive wheel](https://realiracing.com/blog/grip-pressure-hand-position-direct-drive-wheel-iracing.html): Why a death grip hides force feedback detail in iRacing, how to hold a direct drive wheel, and a practice routine to test your own grip pressure.
- [ISDE 2018 in Chile: My Motocross Clips | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/isde-2018-vina-del-mar-chile-final-motocross.html): I filmed the 2018 ISDE in Viña del Mar, Chile: the final motocross on November 17, plus an enduro mass start.
- [Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach 2018: My Fan Footage](https://realiracing.com/blog/long-beach-grand-prix-2018-from-the-grandstand.html): My own clips from the 2018 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach: IndyCars, Stadium Super Trucks and the Mothers Exotic Car Paddock.
- [Monaco and Cannes Supercar Spotting 2025 | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/monaco-cannes-supercars-summer-2025.html): Phone clips I filmed myself in Monaco and Cannes in summer 2025: a Ferrari F40, Casino Square, a Bugatti Chiron and more.
- [Monsters on the Beach 2011: Virginia Beach Fence Clips](https://realiracing.com/blog/monsters-on-the-beach-2011-virginia-beach-monster-trucks.html): My own fence-side clips from Monsters on the Beach 2011 on the Virginia Beach oceanfront, with Grave Digger and Stone Crusher.
